name: Exp_ColorX2MA_Digit
summary: This EA trades based on the ColorX2MA_Digit custom indicator, which uses a dual moving average crossover system with digit rounding. It opens buy positions when the indicator transitions from neutral (0) to bullish (>0), and sell positions when it transitions from neutral (2) to bearish (<2), with configurable money management and position closing logic.
summary_zh: 该EA基于ColorX2MA_Digit自定义指标进行交易，该指标使用双重移动平均线交叉系统并进行数字舍入。当指标从中性状态(0)转为看涨(>0)时开多仓，从中性状态(2)转为看跌(<2)时开空仓，具有可配置的资金管理和仓位关闭逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用双重平滑移动平均线交叉策略，使用两种不同的平滑方法（MA_Method1和MA_Method2）分别计算快慢均线。入场条件：当指标缓冲区值从0变为大于0时产生买入信号，从2变为小于2时产生卖出信号，本质上是一种趋势跟踪策略，捕捉均线交叉的趋势方向变化。出场条件：买入信号同时触发卖出仓位平仓，卖出信号同时触发买入仓位平仓，形成反向信号平仓机制，同时设有固定的止损和止盈（StopLoss=1000点，TakeProfit=2000点）。仓位管理采用多种模式，包括按自由保证金比例、按余额比例、按亏损后保证金比例、按亏损后余额比例以及固定手数（默认LOT模式，0.1手）。资金管理通过MarginMode枚举实现多种计算方式，允许灵活的风险控制，但缺乏加仓、减仓或追踪止损等高级功能。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a dual smoothed moving average crossover strategy using two different smoothing methods (MA_Method1 and MA_Method2) to calculate fast and slow moving averages respectively. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when the indicator buffer value transitions from 0 to greater than 0, and a sell signal when it transitions from 2 to less than 2, which is fundamentally a trend-following approach capturing directional changes at MA crossovers. Exit conditions: a buy signal simultaneously triggers closing of sell positions, and a sell signal triggers closing of buy positions, implementing a reverse-signal exit mechanism alongside fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points). Position sizing supports multiple modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage after-loss margin, percentage after-loss balance, and fixed lot size (default LOT mode at 0.1 lots). Money management is implemented through the MarginMode enumeration offering flexible risk control, but lacks advanced features such as position scaling, partial closes, or trailing stops.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（自由保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/net margin/net balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许买入平仓（平空仓）
parameters.description_en: Allow buy-side close (close sell on opposite signal)

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description: 是否允许卖出平仓（平多仓）
parameters.description_en: Allow sell-side close (close buy on opposite signal)

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 信号检测的K线索引（0=当前K线，1=已完成K线）

pros: 使用双重平滑算法（支持JJMA、JurX、T3等多种高级平滑方法），信号质量优于简单均线交叉
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活性高，适应不同风险偏好
设有止损止盈和滑点控制，基本风险控制到位
可独立开关买卖方向的开仓和平仓，策略配置灵活
使用已完成K线（SignalBar=1）检测信号，避免重绘和虚假信号
pros_en: Uses dual smoothing algorithms supporting advanced methods (JJMA, JurX, T3, etc.), producing higher quality signals than simple MA crossovers
Supports multiple money management modes with high flexibility to accommodate different risk preferences
Includes stop loss, take profit, and slippage control for basic risk management
Independent toggle switches for buy/sell open and close directions provide flexible strategy configuration
Uses completed bar (SignalBar=1) for signal detection, avoiding repainting and false signals
cons: 缺乏追踪止损功能，趋势行情中可能过早止盈或利润回吐过多
止损1000点和止盈2000点为固定值，未考虑市场波动率（ATR）动态调整，不同品种适应性差
没有价差过滤和交易时间过滤，可能在高滑点或低流动性时段开仓
反向信号平仓机制可能导致长时间持仓期间利润大幅回撤后才平仓
缺少持仓检查和重复开仓保护，极端情况下可能重复建仓
cons_en: Lacks trailing stop functionality, potentially taking profit too early or giving back excessive profits in trending markets
Fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points) do not adapt to market volatility (ATR), reducing adaptability across different instruments
No spread filter or trading session filter, potentially opening positions during high slippage or low liquidity periods
Reverse-signal exit mechanism may cause significant profit drawdown before closing during prolonged positions
Missing position check and duplicate entry protection, potentially causing repeated position opening in extreme cases
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈，使风险管理适应不同市场波动率
添加追踪止损和保本止损功能，在趋势行情中锁定利润
增加价差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免不利交易环境
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and take profit to adapt risk management to varying market volatility
Implement trailing stop and breakeven functionality to lock in profits during trending markets
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid unfavorable trading conditions

risk_points: 缺乏持仓检查，可能在已有同方向仓位时重复开仓
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率，在低波动市场止损过大、高波动市场止盈过小
没有追踪止损，趋势交易中利润回撤风险较高
没有价差过滤，点差扩大时可能导致不合理的入场
risk_points_en: Missing position check, potentially opening duplicate positions in the same direction
Fixed stop loss/take profit ignores market volatility — SL too wide in low-volatility and TP too tight in high-volatility markets
No trailing stop creates significant profit drawdown risk in trending trades
No spread filter may cause unreasonable entries when spreads widen
